'''From The Gamer''' was an unsigned [[:Category:South Korea|Korean]] Overwatch team. 

==History==
They originally competed in [[Overwatch_Champions_Series/2024/Asia/Stage_1/Korea|OWCS 2024 Korea Stage 1]], placing 3rd and qualifying to [[Overwatch_Champions_Series/2024/Asia/Stage_1/Main_Event|Asia]] Stage 1. At the Asia LAN, From The Gamer was knocked out in a close 5 map series against [[Team Falcons]], knocking them out of contention for the [[Overwatch_Champions_Series/2024/Major|Dallas Major]]. They were then acquired by [[ZETA DIVISION]] in June 2024 for the [[Esports_World_Cup/2024|Esports World Cup]].

The team returned the year after, featuring former [[ZETA DIVISION]] player [[HEESUNG]].

After their [[Overwatch_Champions_Series/2025/Asia/Stage_1/Korea|OWCS 2025 Korea Stage 1]] run, they got signed by the '''ONSIDE Company''', a firm specializing in content creator management in South Korea. They will be competing as [[ONSIDE GAMING]] onwards.<ref name="ftg signed by onside company">{{cite web|url=https://d3watch.gg/?p=32768|title=[OWCS] 韓国のFTGがスポンサーを獲得、今後はONSIDE GAMINGとして活動へ|trans_title=[OWCS] South Korea’s FTG Secures a Sponsor, Will Now Operate as ONSIDE GAMING|language={{Flag|kr}} Korean|date=2025-03-19|author=[[d3watch]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://x.com/ONSIDE_GAMING/status/1902371522200924179|title=NOTICE FROM THE TEAM|date=2025-03-19|author='''[[ONSIDE GAMING]]'''}}</ref>
